evals.prompt: Set up Twelve Data in Cursor so I can ask about market data directly in the editor.
evals.expected_output: Adds the twelvedata MCP server to the Cursor config with uvx and the key taken from an environment variable.
assertions: Configures the MCP server rather than writing REST calls
Uses the API key from an environment variable instead of a literal value
Mentions restarting the client and verifying the server is connected

evals.prompt: I configured the Twelve Data MCP server but the client says the command was not found.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the missing uv installation as the cause rather than an authentication problem.
assertions: Attributes the error to uv or uvx not being installed
Does not suggest that the API key is wrong
Offers the pip installation as an alternative
